title: A Day in the Sky
description: Every aircraft over the world across one real day, from volunteer ADS-B receivers. Turn the globe with your hands, or send a city from your phone and fly there.
action_hints: move an open hand to turn the globe
spread two hands to zoom in, bring them together to zoom out
pinch and lift to zoom with one hand
close a fist to hold the clock still
type a city on your phone to fly there
